interface: VM Apps Org - Provisioning Service IaaS API

source.statement: This contract is derived from Broadcom's authoritative VCF Automation 9.0 xAPIs reference documentation. Its source is reference documentation rather than a published specification.
source.specificationRepositoryNote: VCF Automation has no specification in the Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository.

queryParameters.name: $orderBy
queryParameters.description: Sorting criteria in property (asc|desc) form; multiple criteria are supported.

queryParameters.name: $count
queryParameters.description: When present, shows the total number of records, or the number matching a filter.

queryParameters.name: $filter
queryParameters.description: Predicate expression used to filter results.

totalElements.description: Total number of elements; the reference notes that this field may not be populated in some cases.

numberOfElements.description: Number of elements in the current page.

localIntegrationProfile.purpose: Retrieve the complete project collection and return it in a stable order.
stableOutputOrder: name ascending using ordinal case-sensitive comparison
id ascending using ordinal case-sensitive comparison
